## Contribution type

- [ ] Add a plugin record
- [ ] Update a plugin record

## Review checklist

- [ ] The changed record is under `data/plugins/` and its filename matches `slug`.
- [ ] The record follows `schemas/plugin-record.schema.json` and uses an allowed category and tag set.
- [ ] The repository and optional homepage URLs are public HTTPS links.
- [ ] The record is not a duplicate by ID or slug.
- [ ] The description and notes are factual and supported by public evidence.
- [ ] No secrets, private source, personal data, scores, findings, or analysis results are included.
- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run validate` pass.

## Public evidence

Link to the public source that supports this change.
